prose: Basis: the Techmeme summary of Anthropic's own announcement; the company post was not fetched. Anthropic says it is committing 5% of its shares to a Public Benefit Fund, reaching roughly 20% together with co-founder and staff pledges, with the stake growing 2% for every 50% rise in valuation.
The fund is a new entity whose structure increases its share as the company grows; details are in the wiki's entry on the announcement itself.
highlights: Anthropic commits 5% of shares to a Public Benefit Fund
~20% total with co-founder and staff pledges
